scope: Synthetic 45-validator, one round, empty transaction blocks. HTTP bytes plus WebSocket frames counted on proxy TCP socket reads/writes, excluding TCP/IP, ACKs, TLS. Includes load setup and final oracle capture; fixture-control and metrics traffic excluded. No real chain access.
measurementCaveats: Interval starts after fixture readiness and includes load setup plus final oracle capture; no initial application/collector warmup.
Twenty-second hold plus three-second ramp; no 30-second validator/block-time refresh or five-minute upgrade refresh fell within either measurement window.
One-user case is an investigator; 150-user case is 75 dashboard and 75 investigators. Browser rates should not be compared as a per-user scaling factor.
Reverse proxies count bytes on their backend TCP socket read/write calls, including HTTP headers and WebSocket frames but excluding TCP/IP, acknowledgements, retransmissions and TLS.
Fixture control and metrics requests bypass the counters. No real node or production application was contacted.
